title: Fae Porter's move trigger lets the chosen unit be moved to ANY battlefield instead of the same battlefield Fae Porter moved to.
expected: Fae Porter (packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/fae-porter.ts) has no hand-authored abilities, so enrich-cards.ts parses rulesText at load. Running parseAbilities on its text yields effect {type:'move', target:{type:'unit',controller:'friendly'}, to:'choose'}. Root cause in packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-move.ts:243-266 (flexMoveMatch): the regex ends with a mandatory `(?:\s+.*)$`, so for "Move a unit you control to the same battlefield." the optional `to` group backtracks to empty and " to the same battlefield." is swallowed by the trailing clause — toStr is undefined and line 265 emits to:'choose' (verified: match groups = ["a",null,"unit",null]). Even if captured, parseLocationString (parser/impl/targets.ts:112-135) has no case for "the same battlefield" and would fall through to "base"; nothing maps it to the engine's `to:'same'`. The engine does support the correct semantics — abilities/effects/move.ts:647-651 uses ctx.triggerToZone when dest === 'same' — but with dest === 'choose' it takes move.ts:564-598, offering base + every battlefield as a choose-destination prompt, matching the observed behavior (unit could be sent to Altar to Unity instead of Aspirant's Climb).
observed: Effect is encoded as {type:'move', to:'choose'}; after picking Overzealous Fan a 'choose-destination' pendingChoice offered both battlefields (Aspirant's Climb AND Altar to Unity). Picking Altar to Unity was accepted and Overzealous Fan ended up at battlefield-player-2-bf-ogn-275-298 while Fae Porter sat at battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-276-298. pendingChoice even carried triggerToZone=battlefield-player-1-bf-ogn-276-298 but it was not enforced.
